projects.title: Traders Weekly EM
projects.description: Weekly expected moves (EM = Spot x ATM IV x sqrt(DTE/365), +MMM on earnings weeks) with Friday close and EM low / high. Online numbers come from yFinance every market hour; start_server.bat on the PC gives live numbers.

projects.title: MMM - Options Cone Simulator
projects.description: Expected-move cone for Cash-Secured Puts, Covered Calls, Buy Calls and Buy Puts: type the numbers and read EM, chance ITM / touch / profit, reach date, break-even, returns, option values and NOW odds, each with its worked math. Get price fills the stock price, the next earnings date and the option's bid / ask / last. Big P/L monitor at the top (Covered Call: stock + call total, if called / not called, cost after premium). Saved plays, CSV and PDF report. User Guide (PDF) button in the header opens the full guide with worked examples. Same math as the TOS MMM studies.

projects.title: Research Watchlist
projects.description: Research Watchlist LITE: personal stock research watchlist with yFinance prices and fundamentals, groups, notes, alarms and CSV / PDF export. Hosted on Render's free plan, so the first open after a quiet spell can take up to a minute while it wakes up.

projects.title: GEX Layout
projects.description: One-page reference for the seven GEX layouts (A-G): gamma flip vs call wall and put wall, what to look for, what to avoid. Layout checker with the worked math, EM left (0DTE expected move still left to 16:00 ET) vs the walls, PDF.
